calls.statement:
SELECT COUNT(*) as web_orders_placed
FROM fact_web_order
WHERE DATE(order_ts_utc) = '2025-12-01'

SELECT 
  DATE(order_ts_utc) as order_date,
  day_name,
  COUNT(*) as order_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT web_order_id) as distinct_orders
FROM fact_web_order
INNER JOIN dim_date ON DATE(fact_web_order.order_ts_utc) = dim_date.calendar_date
WHERE DATE(order_ts_utc) = '2025-12-01'
GROUP BY DATE(order_ts_utc), day_name
